name: Quad Cities Sunday 2025
information: While we welcome first-timers at this competition, it is geared towards more experienced competitors. First timers are encouraged to check out [Quad Cities Saturday 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuadCitiesSaturday2025) on Saturday instead. These competitions are not in series, so competitors may compete at one or both of the competitions.
